lines.en: label mollydorm10:
I knock on Molly’s door and wait to see if she’s around.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Molly 的门，等着看她在不在。

lines.en: I can hear the sound effects from some game or anime going off in the background, so I imagine she is.
lines.zh: 我能听见背景里传来某款游戏或者动画的音效，所以想她应该在。

lines.en: Tsuneyo doesn’t seem like she would be the type to spend her free time on that, so process of elimination really only leaves the one I came here to see in the first place.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 看起来不像是会把空闲时间花在这上面的人，所以排除法下来，房间里只剩我本来就打算见的那个人。

lines.en: : Who goes there?!
lines.zh: : 来者何人？！

lines.en: : Your teacher.
lines.zh: : 你的老师。

lines.en: : Oh, Master!
lines.zh: : 哦，主人！

lines.en: : You may enter!
lines.zh: : 您可以进来了！

lines.en: I grab the handle and attempt to open the door, but it appears to be locked.
lines.zh: 我抓住门把手想要开门，可门似乎是锁着的。

lines.en: : I can’t enter if the door is locked, Molly.
lines.zh: : 门锁着的话我可进不去啊，Molly。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhhh, crap. Give me a second.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，靠。等我一下。

lines.en: : I’m in the middle of a thing in a game.
lines.zh: : 我游戏里正忙着呢。

lines.en: : Can’t you just pause it?
lines.zh: : 你就不能暂停一下吗？

lines.en: : Pause it? What year is this, 2005?
lines.zh: : 暂停？老师您这是哪年，2005 年吗？

lines.en: : Have I activated my time-jump ability on accident?!
lines.zh: : 难道我不小心发动了时间跳跃能力？！

lines.en: : Just...hurry up and finish your game. It always feels strange standing in the middle of the hallway here.
lines.zh: : 就……赶紧打完你的游戏。站在这走廊中间总觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Roger! Just gotta pop my CD’s and...
lines.zh: : 收到！我得先把 CD 甩完，然后……

lines.en: : Done!
lines.zh: : 搞定！

lines.en: I hear a set of frantic footsteps clopping against the floor as Molly rushes to the door and pulls it open.
lines.zh: 我听见一阵急促的脚步声啪嗒啪嗒踩过地板，Molly 冲到门口把门拉开。

lines.en: scene black
: What ever happened to the good old days where you were able to pause video games?
lines.zh: : 以前电子游戏还能暂停的好日子都哪儿去了？

lines.en: scene mollydormten1
: Those days have long since vanished, Sir. Lost like teardrops in the rain.
lines.zh: : 那种日子早就一去不返了，老师。就像雨中的泪滴一样消失无踪。

lines.en: : Insightful. Is that a line out of a dating game?
lines.zh: : 挺有见地。这是恋爱游戏里的台词吧？

lines.en: : Probably, Sir. Though I don’t know which one off the top of my head.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧，老师。不过我一时想不起是哪一部了。

lines.en: Molly begins to play with one of the sleeves of her hoodie, incessantly plucking at the same spot over and over again.
lines.zh: Molly 开始摆弄起她连帽衫的一只袖子，不停地在同一处揪来揪去。

lines.en: She looks surprisingly cute in her...rather Irish-themed pajamas.
lines.zh: 她穿着那身……相当爱尔兰风的睡衣，看起来意外地可爱。

lines.en: I can’t help but notice a rather fresh aroma permeating throughout the room as well.
lines.zh: 我还忍不住注意到，房间里弥漫着一股相当清新的香气。

lines.en: : What is that smell?
lines.zh: : 这是什么味道？

lines.en: : Me, Sir. Lemon scented shampoo.
lines.zh: : 我啊，老师。柠檬味洗发水。

lines.en: : I just took a bath with Ami and Maya.
lines.zh: : 我刚跟 Ami 和 Maya 一起洗了澡。

lines.en: : We were discussing the logistics of our upcoming campaign at the edge of the world.
lines.zh: : 我们在讨论即将在世界尽头展开的战役的后勤问题。

lines.en: : You mean the beach?
lines.zh: : 你是说海边？

lines.en: : I do, Sir. The beach is what it appears as to those not blessed with clairvoyance.
lines.zh: : 正是，老师。对那些没被赐予千里眼的人来说，它看上去就是海边。

lines.en: : But people like you and I see it for what it truly is.
lines.zh: : 但像你我这样的人，能看见它真正的样子。

lines.en: : I see it as a beach.
lines.zh: : 我看它就是个海边。

lines.en: : You will know the meaning in time, Sir. A beach is not simply a beach when it is filled with blossoming [young]ladies like myself, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，您早晚会明白其中真意的。当海边挤满了像我这样含苞待放的 [young]淑女时，它就不再只是海边了，老师。

lines.en: : A true haven for degeneracy. A real set-up for top-notch H-scenes and lost bikini tops.
lines.zh: : 一个真正的废柴圣地。一场顶级 H 场景和走光泳衣的完美舞台。

lines.en: : I think you watch too much anime.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你动画看太多了。

lines.en: : {i}Though, I guess none of that sounds bad to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过嘛，这些听着倒也不坏。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollydormten2
: There is no such thing as too much anime. Especially when there are so many cute figures to collect.
lines.zh: : 动画看得再多也不嫌多。尤其是还有那么多可爱手办可以收集。

lines.en: : You’re still planning on getting more? You have plenty.
lines.zh: : 你还打算继续买？你已经有一大堆了。

lines.en: : Always, Sir. I will spend every penny I earn from the cafe and the pictures you purchase from me on objects to fuel my passion.
lines.zh: : 永远都会买，老师。我要把在咖啡厅挣的每一分钱，还有您从我这儿买的每一张照片的钱，都砸在供奉我热情的物件上。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, do you happen to have any of those pictures yet?
lines.zh: : 说起这个，你手上有那些照片了吗？

lines.en: : Plenty of time has passed by, so if you don't have any, you owe me a good excuse.
lines.zh: : 都过去这么久了，你要是没有，总得给我个像样的借口。

lines.en: scene mollydormten3
: I regret to inform you that I do not have any. Please accept the following excuse.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾地通知您，我一张都没有。请接受以下这个借口。

lines.en: : The stuff I ordered online just came in the other day and none of it really fits. I’m growing at an alarming rate.
lines.zh: : 我前两天刚收到网上订的东西，结果全都穿不下。我正以惊人的速度长个子。

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time believing that. You’re one of the smallest girls in the class.
lines.zh: : 这话我可不太信。你是班里个子最小的女生之一。

lines.en: scene mollydormten4
: Day by day, I stray further and further from the loli tag.
lines.zh: : 一天又一天，我离 loli 这个标签越来越远了。

lines.en: : Who will ever love me if I become an average-sized girl?
lines.zh: : 要是我变成了普通身材的女生，还会有人爱我吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I think you’d be cute either way.
lines.zh: : 我说啊，你什么样都可爱。

lines.en: scene mollydormten5
: Thank you, Sir. I would return the compliment if you had one less dimension.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，老师。要是您少一个维度，我本来会回敬您一句的。

lines.en: : You’re sure blushing a lot for someone who isn’t interested in 3D characters.
lines.zh: : 一个对 3D 角色没兴趣的人，脸红得可真厉害啊。

lines.en: : Hormones, Sir.
lines.zh: : 荷尔蒙而已，老师。

lines.en: : They control the brains of [young]women like myself and make us act in ways we normally regret.
lines.zh: : 它控制着像我这样的 [young]女性的大脑，让我们做出平时会后悔的事。

lines.en: : Is that Mollyspeak for saying you’re getting turned on?
lines.zh: : 这是 Molly 语里「你被撩到了」的意思吗？

lines.en: scene mollydormten6
: O-Of course not! What would the players think if an innocent virgin like me received her first H-scene in her initial update?!
lines.zh: : 当、当然不是！像我这样清纯的处女，要是在初始更新里就迎来第一个 H 场景，玩家会怎么想啊？！

lines.en: : I’m sure there would be plenty of players who’d be absolutely thrilled by that.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，会有大批玩家为此激动得不行。

lines.en: scene mollydormten7
: Guh...I’m not ready to grow up yet...
lines.zh: : 呃……我还没准备好长大……

lines.en: : I haven’t even unlocked the fabled “first kiss” CG.
lines.zh: : 我连传说中的「初吻」CG 都还没解锁呢。

lines.en: : Kissing is overrated anyway. Once you get older, you’ll realize that relationships become more about sex than actual affection.
lines.zh: : 接吻本来就被高估了。等你再大一点就会明白，恋爱关系更多是关于性，而不是真正的感情。

lines.en: : Well, in my experience at least.
lines.zh: : 至少以我的经验是这样。

lines.en: scene mollydormten8
: Sir, this may be hard for you to hear, but I’m beginning to feel a bit uncomfortable with the direction this conversation is headed.
lines.zh: : 老师，这话您可能不爱听，但我开始觉得这个话题的走向让我有点不自在了。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to talk about sex in games, but the real life kind sounds...scary.
lines.zh: : 游戏里谈性是一回事，现实里的那种听起来……很吓人。

lines.en: scene mollydormten9
: Though...I suppose if you were to use a command seal...
lines.zh: : 不过……我想如果您动用令咒的话……

lines.en: : I would be forced to oblige...
lines.zh: : 我就只能从命了……

lines.en: Molly is clearly starting to get a little flustered, so I might as well take things down a notch before I actually do something to hurt her.
lines.zh: Molly 显然开始有点慌了，所以在我真的做出什么伤害她的事之前，我还是把节奏放慢一点吧。

lines.en: Despite being a full on, admissible pervert when it comes to video games, she still clearly isn’t ready for the actual thing yet.
lines.zh: 尽管在电子游戏这件事上，她是个彻底、并且公开承认的变态，但她显然还没准备好面对真货。

lines.en: But I guess that’s not too hard to understand given the type of person she is.
lines.zh: 不过想想她是什么样的人，这一点倒也不难理解。

lines.en: It seems that Molly is willing to do virtually anything in order to separate herself from the real world.
lines.zh: 看起来 Molly 愿意为了把自己和现实世界隔开，去做几乎任何事。

lines.en: And if deflowering every character in every game she plays is how she wants to do that, more power to her.
lines.zh: 而如果把她玩的每一款游戏里的每个角色都推倒，就是她想用来做到这一点的方式，那就随她去吧。

lines.en: scene mollydormten10
: Oh! Sir!
lines.zh: : 哦！老师！

lines.en: : Wow. You got over that whole 'hormonal embarrassment' thing pretty quickly.
lines.zh: : 哇。你从刚才那阵「荷尔蒙羞耻」里恢复得还挺快啊。

lines.en: : ADHD, Sir. There's not a lot of space on my hard drive so I need to constantly delete things to make place for new ones.
lines.zh: : 多动症嘛，老师。我的硬盘空间不多，所以得不停删东西给新东西腾地方。

lines.en: : Gotcha. So what is it that captured your mind this time around?
lines.zh: : 懂了。那么这次是什么抓住了你的脑子？

lines.en: scene mollydormten11
Molly moves several steps closer to her computer and starts to look at something in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: Molly 往她电脑那边走了几步，开始盯着房间角落里的什么东西看。

lines.en: I stare at the same corner as well and see nothing, so I’m not quite sure what it is she’s looking at.
lines.zh: 我也盯着同一个角落看，可什么都没看见，所以我不太确定她到底在看什么。

lines.en: : I actually have something I’d like to confide in you about.
lines.zh: : 其实我有件事想向您倾诉。

lines.en: : Oh? What’s with the sudden shift in tone?
lines.zh: : 哦？怎么突然换了个调子？

lines.en: : I will explain the step-by-step process as to how I wound up here.
lines.zh: : 我会分步骤说明，我是怎么走到今天这一步的。

lines.en: : It all began with the mention of sex.
lines.zh: : 一切始于提到了性。

lines.en: : Which then made me think about nudity.
lines.zh: : 然后让我想到了裸体。

lines.en: : Which then made me think about my own personal experiences with nudity.
lines.zh: : 然后让我想到了我自己跟裸体有关的经历。

lines.en: : Which then reminded me of something I saw recently.
lines.zh: : 然后让我想起了最近看到的一件事。

lines.en: : Which then somehow distracted me from thinking about the thing that made me think about all of those things in the first place.
lines.zh: : 然后不知怎么的，就把最初让我想到这些的那件事给岔开了。

lines.en: : I’m...not sure if I follow.
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定我听懂了。

lines.en: : Then I will get right to the point.
lines.zh: : 那我就直说了。

lines.en: scene mollydormten12
: What is the right thing to do when you find out that someone you care about is hurting themself?
lines.zh: : 当你发现自己在乎的人在伤害自己时，该怎么做才对？

lines.en: : I think I saw something I wasn’t supposed to see.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我看到了不该看的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t know what to do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Is it okay if I ask for a few more details?
lines.zh: : 我能再问几个细节吗？

lines.en: I’m almost positive I know what this is about, but I don’t want to reveal anything until I’m sure.
lines.zh: 我几乎可以确定我知道这是怎么回事，但在确定之前，我不想透露任何东西。

lines.en: scene mollydormten13
: Well...Let’s just say that girls sometimes use the same dressing room as one another when they go shopping.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这么说吧，女生逛街的时候，有时会跟彼此用同一间更衣室。

lines.en: : And a girl I happened to be changing with had some marks on her that I’m smart enough to recognize.
lines.zh: : 而我正好跟她一起换衣服的那个女生，身上有一些痕迹，我还没笨到认不出来。

lines.en: : I might be a huge geek, but I know when to snap out of it.
lines.zh: : 我可能是个超级宅，但我知道什么时候该从宅状态里清醒过来。

lines.en: scene mollydormten14
: I obviously didn’t say anything because like, what do you even say when you see something like that?
lines.zh: : 我当然什么都没说，因为，看到那种东西你到底能说什么啊？

lines.en: : “Are you okay? What happened? Do you need help?”
lines.zh: : 「你还好吗？发生了什么？需要帮忙吗？」

lines.en: : Those are all things that would make her catch on.
lines.zh: : 这些话全都会让她察觉到。

lines.en: scene mollydormten15
: And now I’m in this weird place where there are a million things I wanna say but none of them will come out because I’m afraid of people getting mad at me.
lines.zh: : 现在我处在一个很奇怪的境地，有一肚子话想说，可一句都说不出来，因为我怕别人生我的气。

lines.en: : This person sounds really important to you.
lines.zh: : 这个人对你来说好像非常重要。

lines.en: scene mollydormten16
: Yeah.
: They are.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Very important.
lines.zh: : 非常重要。

lines.en: : Like, so important that I just wanna squeeze her and be like “Wake up!” and not let go until she promises to not do anything like that again.
lines.zh: : 重要到我只想一把抱住她，说「醒醒！」，然后一直不放手，直到她答应再也不做那种事为止。

lines.en: scene mollydormten17
: My mom killed herself when I was little. So ever since then I’ve tried to be really conscious about how other people feel.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈在我很小的时候自杀了。所以从那以后，我一直努力去留意别人的感受。

lines.en: : But even when you know they’re not feeling well, it’s not like you can actually do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 可就算你知道她们不好受，你其实也什么都做不了。

lines.en: : You can’t even make jokes because then it will seem like you’re just brushing everything off.
lines.zh: : 你连玩笑都不能开，因为那样看起来就像你在把一切都当儿戏。

lines.en: : So I wanna know what you would do in my position.
lines.zh: : 所以我想知道，如果您处在我的位置会怎么做。

lines.en: scene mollydormten18
: Hahah...Hahahah! Pretty crazy how we wound up here all of a sudden, right?
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈哈哈！我们怎么突然就聊到这儿来了，挺疯的吧？

lines.en: : The dorms must be possessed by some kind of dark entity or something! Right?
lines.zh: : 宿舍肯定是被什么黑暗实体附身了之类的！对吧？

lines.en: : That’s gotta be it!
lines.zh: : 肯定是这么回事！

lines.en: scene mollydormten19
: That’s gotta be it...
lines.zh: : 肯定是这么回事……

lines.en: : And it’s gotten to her too. And it’s making her do weird things to her arms.
lines.zh: : 而且它也缠上她了。是它在让她对自己的手臂做那些奇怪的事。

lines.en: : So all we need to do is take down whatever entity is spreading all of these negative emotions around and everything will go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 所以我们只要打倒那个在四处散播这些负面情绪的实体，一切就会恢复正常。

lines.en: scene mollydormten20
: Everything will go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 一切都会恢复正常。

lines.en: : It’s all just part of an evil conspiracy.
lines.zh: : 这一切都只是某个邪恶阴谋的一部分。

lines.en: Molly picks at the fabric of her clothes even harder than before.
lines.zh: Molly 比刚才更用力地揪着自己衣服的布料。

lines.en: Her hands are shaking as tears begin to slowly but surely stream down her pale, white cheeks and drip onto the sleeves of her hoodie.
lines.zh: 她的手在发抖，眼泪开始缓缓地、却毫无疑问地顺着她苍白的脸颊流下来，滴在连帽衫的袖子上。

lines.en: Meanwhile, I sit across from her...At a table the same girl she’s so concerned about often shows up to in order to play games and get away from everything.
lines.zh: 与此同时，我坐在她对面……坐在一张桌子旁，而她那么担心的那个女生，常常会出现在这张桌子前打游戏、逃避一切。

lines.en: We’re all looking to get away from everything. And we all have different ways to do that.
lines.zh: 我们都想逃避一切。而每个人都有不同的方式。

lines.en: But what happens when someone you know forgets how?
lines.zh: 可如果你认识的人忘了该怎么逃避呢？

lines.en: What do you do?
lines.zh: 你该怎么办？

lines.en: I doubt Molly {i}wanted{/i} to talk about this at all.
lines.zh: 我猜 Molly 根本就不{i}想{/i}谈这件事。

lines.en: It just managed to grab hold of her and force her head underwater before she could do anything about it.
lines.zh: 它只是抓住了她，在她来得及做任何事之前，就把她的头按进了水里。

lines.en: And so everything just started to leak out.
lines.zh: 于是所有东西就这么漏了出来。

lines.en: Everything always leaks out.
lines.zh: 所有东西总是会漏出来。

lines.en: : This sounds like a job for your master.
lines.zh: : 这听起来该由您的主人出马了。

lines.en: scene mollydormten21
: Come on...Don’t drop the act now.
lines.zh: : 拜托……别现在出戏啊。

lines.en: : I finally start playing along and you’re going to give me that face?
lines.zh: : 我好不容易开始配合你演了，你就给我这种表情？

lines.en: : If you care so much about this person and you want to get rid of the “demon” or whatever it was you said was possessing them, we just have to defeat it. Right?
lines.zh: : 如果你这么在乎这个人，又想除掉你说的那个附在她身上的「恶魔」什么的，我们只要把它打败就行了。对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe it’s time I show off {i}my{/i} true power?
lines.zh: : 也许是时候让{i}我{/i}展示真正的力量了？

lines.en: : I’m the Supreme whatever it is-
lines.zh: : 我是至高无上的什么来着——

lines.en: scene mollydormten22
: Supreme Overlord. Herald of the Adolescents.
lines.zh: : 至高霸主。青春期的先驱。

lines.en: : Yeah. That thing.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那个。

lines.en: : And besides, I’m pretty sure I know who you’re talking about anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且再说了，我大概已经知道你说的是谁了。

lines.en: scene mollydormten21
: You do?
lines.zh: : 您知道？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s something I’ve known about for a while. And I care about her just as much as you do.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这件事我知道有一阵子了。而我和你一样在乎她。

lines.en: scene mollydormten23
: Oh yeah?
: You dare challenge the love of the Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest?
lines.zh: : 您竟敢质疑水晶森林的翡翠守护者的爱？

lines.en: : You may be my master, but you must know by now that there are aspects of power where even {i}I{/i} surpass you.
lines.zh: : 您也许是我的主人，但您现在总该知道了，有些方面的力量，连{i}我{/i}都超过您。

lines.en: Her eyes return to the same corner she’s continuously focused on throughout this impromptu confession.
lines.zh: 她的目光又回到了这场临时告白中她一直盯着看的那个角落。

lines.en: I guess it’s a habit of hers. Just like plucking at the strings of fabric on her clothing.
lines.zh: 我想这是她的习惯。就像揪衣服上的线头一样。

lines.en: It’s great being able to find things that will calm you down while your mind runs wild.
lines.zh: 在脑子乱成一团的时候，能找到让自己冷静下来的东西，是件好事。

lines.en: You need to stay grounded or you’ll eventually just float off into the ether.
lines.zh: 你得让自己脚踩在地上，不然总有一天会飘进虚空里。

lines.en: There’s your half-assed philosophy for the day, coming from a man who seems to always just-so-happen to be around girls when they start to cry.
lines.zh: 以上就是今天半吊子的人生哲学，出自一个似乎总是在女生开始哭的时候刚好就在旁边的男人之口。

lines.en: Sometimes, I wonder if they’d cry at all if I were to just leave.
lines.zh: 有时候我会想，如果我就这么走了，她们到底还会不会哭。

lines.en: : There’s no need to challenge anyone here. It’s clear how worried you are by how you’re acting right now.
lines.zh: : 这里不需要质疑任何人。从你现在这副样子，就能看出你有多担心。

lines.en: : That’s because of the dark entity.
lines.zh: : 那都是因为黑暗实体。

lines.en: : Right. The dark entity.
lines.zh: : 对。黑暗实体。

lines.en: : So if the dark entity happens to wipe our memories of this conversation, everything will be just like it was before, right?
lines.zh: : 那么如果黑暗实体碰巧抹掉了我们这段对话的记忆，一切就会跟以前一样了，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollydormten24
: It can do that?!
lines.zh: : 它还能做到那种事？！

lines.en: : It’s even more powerful than I thought!
lines.zh: : 它比我想的还要强大！

lines.en: : Are you sure you’ll be able to handle it, Master?
lines.zh: : 主人，您确定对付得了它吗？

lines.en: : I may be small, but I’m willing to assist you in any possible way. Just name it!
lines.zh: : 我虽然个子小，但我愿意尽一切可能协助您。尽管开口！

lines.en: It’s hard for me to tell if Molly is just acting right now or if all of these words are her true feelings wrapped in intentionally faked delusions of grandeur.
lines.zh: 我很难判断 Molly 现在是在演戏，还是说这些话全都是她的真心话，只不过被包裹在她故意装出来的夸大妄想里。

lines.en: Maybe she {i}does{/i} think that there is something she can do to help bring Rin back to normal.
lines.zh: 也许她{i}真的{/i}觉得自己能做点什么，帮 Rin 恢复正常。

lines.en: But before any of that, I need to find out if something’s actually going on again or if the marks she saw were the same ones I did.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，我得先弄清楚是不是又出事了，还是说她看到的痕迹跟我之前看到的是同一批。

lines.en: : You can assist me by guarding yourself, Molly. You’re of no use to me if you fall victim to the darkness as well.
lines.zh: : 你可以协助我，方法是守护好你自己，Molly。要是你也沦为黑暗的牺牲品，对我可就没用了。

lines.en: scene mollydormten25
: Ahh, an excellent plan, Sir. I will support you from the backlines, just as any good priest would.
lines.zh: : 啊，妙计啊，老师。我会在后方支援您，就像任何一个称职的牧师那样。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to cast Power Word: Shield on you before you pull.
lines.zh: : 我一定会在您开怪之前给您上真言术：盾。

lines.en: : I...wouldn’t have it any other way.
lines.zh: : 我……正希望如此。

lines.en: scene black
We find a way to carry on our conversation without ever directly addressing anything again.
lines.zh: 我们找了个办法把对话继续下去，却再也没有正面提起任何事。

lines.en: Life is easier that way.
lines.zh: 日子那样过起来更轻松。

lines.en: Sometimes, you need to disguise your problems as happier things to avoid {i}the dark entity{/i} consuming you.
lines.zh: 有时候，你得把自己的问题伪装成更快乐的东西，免得被{i}黑暗实体{/i}吞噬。

lines.en: And even if Molly is too much to handle at most hours of the day, I {i}do{/i} want to protect her.
lines.zh: 而就算 Molly 在一天里的大多数时候都让人招架不住，我{i}确实{/i}想要保护她。

lines.en: Just as I want to protect the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: 就像我想保护其他所有女生一样。

lines.en: She doesn’t deserve to be beaten down the way so many others have been.
lines.zh: 她不该像那么多其他人那样被打倒。

lines.en: So if there’s anything I can do about that-
lines.zh: 所以只要我能为此做点什么——

lines.en: I will gladly do it.
lines.zh: 我都心甘情愿。

lines.en: $ molly_love += 3
$ mollydorm10 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
